messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D story-mode tactical shooter for phone/tablet, inspired by Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, with realistic-feeling guns, physics, and high-end visuals.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- User requested an APK larger than 1 GB, but no Android project or APK has been created.

## Decisions
- Implemented a browser-playable campaign prototype, “BLACKTIDE,” as a reasonable assumption given the existing repository had no game code or app framework.
- Used Three.js from a CDN, procedural 3D scene construction, and responsive touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a first-person campaign prototype with intro/debrief screens, terrain/outpost, enemies, objectives, shooting, reloading, health, and keyboard/mouse plus mobile touch controls.
- Verified `node --check --input-type=module < game.js` and browser reload with no console errors.
- Captured a viewport JPEG at `screenshots/blacktide.jpg`.

### Active
- Confirm browser gameplay visually and test the deploy/fire/movement/objective flow; only the intro screen has been captured so far.
- Decide whether to extend this browser prototype into an Android project/build if APK delivery is still expected.

### Blocked
- No APK build tooling or Android project currently exists; the requested >1 GB APK is not delivered.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/blacktide.jpg` and use browser interaction to test deploying and playing.
2. Fix any runtime or gameplay defects found, then capture a gameplay screenshot.
3. If pursuing APK delivery, establish an Android wrapper/build pipeline and clearly assess whether a >1 GB APK is practical.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, mission screens, responsive touch controls, Three.js import map.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, game logic, combat, objectives, enemy behavior, and controls.
- `screenshots/blacktide.jpg`: Latest captured browser viewport.
- `README.md`: Repository project landing page.

## Important Context
- Local browser server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser URL is `http://localhost:3002`.
- Three.js and Google Fonts load externally; offline play is not supported.
- Browser verification succeeded using `playwright-cli open --browser chrome --headed http://localhost:3002`; initial screenshot was taken on the mission intro screen.
- Changes are uncommitted.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable 3D story-mode tactical shooter for phone/tablet, inspired by Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, with realistic-feeling guns, physics, and high-end visuals.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- User requested an APK larger than 1 GB.

## Decisions
- Built a browser-playable campaign prototype, “BLACKTIDE,” because the repository had no existing game or app framework.
- Used Three.js from a CDN, procedural 3D scene construction, and responsive touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a first-person campaign prototype with mission intro/debrief screens, terrain/outpost, enemies, objectives, shooting, reloading, health, and keyboard/mouse plus mobile touch controls.
- Verified `node --check --input-type=module < game.js` and browser reload with no runtime console errors.
- Launched the game in the browser, deployed from the intro screen, and captured both intro and gameplay screenshots.

### Active
- Test combat, movement, and objective progression in browser; gameplay flow has not yet been verified beyond deployment.
- Consider whether to extend the browser prototype into an Android project/build.

### Blocked
- No Android project or APK build pipeline exists; the requested >1 GB APK has not been delivered.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/blacktide-gameplay.jpg` and use browser interaction to test movement, firing, and objective progress.
2. Fix any runtime or gameplay defects found and recapture gameplay screenshot if needed.
3. If pursuing APK delivery, establish an Android wrapper/build pipeline and assess the practicality of a >1 GB APK.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, mission screens, responsive touch controls, Three.js import map.
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, campaign flow, combat, objectives, enemy behavior, and controls.
- `screenshots/blacktide.jpg`: Intro-screen capture.
- `screenshots/blacktide-gameplay.jpg`: Gameplay capture after deployment.
- `README.md`: Repository project landing page.

## Important Context
- Local browser server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser URL is `http://localhost:3002`.
- Three.js and Google Fonts load externally; offline play is unsupported.
- Changes are uncommitted.
